page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top; main text in one column; marginal notes in the right margin (Infinitiuo, praeterito, Optatiuo, Perfecto, plusquam.); catchword/signature at foot: "z 4" centred.

main_text.p: βών, Atqui bellam speciem is intellectu perciperet, qui hoc assequi posset, uel intellectu perceperit, qui hoc assequutus fuerit.
Et Infinitiuo, τί ποιεῖν ἄν, ἢ τί οἴκοι λέγειν. InfinitiuoQuid dicturos fuisse existimatis, aut quid facturos.
Praeterito uero in Indicatiuo, quum de re praeterita loquuntur, τίς ἕτως ἄγριος, ὅστις ἂν ἐδύνατο ἄν τοῦτο ποιεῖν; Quis tam inmitis, qui posset hoc facere? praeterito
Potest hoc & per Optatiuum enuntiari, sed ita ut loqui uideamur in re praesenti, ὅστις ἂν δύναιτο ἄν τοῦτο ποιεῖν, Qui tamen posset hoc facere. Optatiuo

Et inuenitur hoc pacto iunctum praeteritis omnibus, etiam perfectis, & pluSquamperfectis. Perfecto, ut Demosth. Perfecto. πειράσομαι τὸν ξόπον εἰπεῖν, ὃν ἂν μοι δοκεῖ τε μάλιστα παρεσκευάσθαι, Conabor eo modo dicere, quo mihi uidemini, &c. Plusquamperfecto, ὅτι μὲν δεῖ τὰ γράμματα ἐπίστασθαι ἀκηκοέναι, ἄν, Quod quidem oportet scire literas, &c. plusquam.

page.notes: Marginal notes are faint and partly illegible; the Greek in the text is transcribed as far as legible. The running head is set in small capitals and partly worn. Original text reads "DE CONSTRI CONIVN." with the page number 359 (printed as "359"-like form). Some Greek words are uncertain.
